# TengYoda Logistics

TengYoda Logistics is a China-based freight forwarding and supply-chain company serving overseas importers.

Main service: global sea freight booking from China, including FCL, LCL and special-equipment enquiries.

Service network: the Middle East, Red Sea, India and Pakistan, Europe, the Mediterranean, Africa, the east and west coasts of South America, North America, Australia and Southeast Asia.

Supporting services: air freight, DHL/FedEx/UPS express, China procurement, factory pickup, domestic road transport, warehouse receiving, cargo consolidation, oversized freight, RoRo and project cargo.

China network: warehouse and operations support in Foshan, Shenzhen, Qingdao and Yiwu.

Direct contact: Vinson Xie

Email: vinson_xie@tydscc.cn
Website: https://tengyodalogistics.com

Important: service availability, cargo acceptance, transit time and charges depend on the specific cargo, route and destination. Confirm shipment details before booking.
